title: Minecraft Classic
description: Mojang's official browser release of the original 2009 creative build of Minecraft. Wander a small block world and build with the 32 original blocks. No mobs, no survival, and no account needed.
how_to_play: WASD to move, Space to jump and the mouse to look. Use the mouse buttons to break and place blocks. Press B to choose a block, or use the number keys for the hotbar.
